STEP 7 - Energy: Plain bagel ≈ 250–270 kcal/100 g. Toasted topped bagels run slightly higher; I use 265 kcal/100 g. 90 g × 2.65 ≈ 239 kcal.

STEP 8 - Sanity check: One medium bagel, about 90 g and roughly 240 kcal, is plausible for what is visible. No other food is on the plate.
